text:
Maya: opened PR #1002 to rename session_id → request_id across the serving runtime and client libs. Mostly mechanical, but left a couple spots that need eyeballs (env vars, metric names). Can someone take a quick look? cc @raj @olivia

Raj: ack — will skim after stand. One question: do we have a migration plan for existing Prometheus dashboards/alerts? queries will change if we switch metric names straight away.

Maya: good call. added a short migration plan in the PR description and included a metric alias shim for one release so dashboards don't break immediately.

Olivia: quick nit in experiments/service_test.go — you renamed var `sid` -> `rid` but left a comment saying "session id" and the test name still has "session". can we update those for clarity? tiny but will help future searches.

Maya: yep, will update the comment and test name in a follow-up commit. also format-bot complained about formatting on one file.

format-bot: pre-commit check failed: formatting issues in pkg/serving/handler.go. Run `./scripts/format` or `gofmt -w .` and re-push.

Sam: I can push the format commit once Maya updates the test/comment, to keep the single-author history clean.

Maya: pushed the comment/test rename and ran the formatter. PTAL @raj @olivia — I need 1 approval to merge before EOD so this can make the canary cut.

Raj: skimmed the diff, left one inline about env var default fallback. aside from that :+1: pending CI.

Olivia: LGTM after Raj's tiny suggestion. approved.

Maya: thanks — merging once CI green. I'll watch the canary for errors and have a rollback ready if anything odd shows up.

Sam: sounds good. :rocket:

Maya: (also leaving a note in #eng-oncall about the rename so SRE knows to expect metric label changes next week when we remove the shim)
